notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes: Fix bug where color changes on certain avatar details are not saved.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the cat sometimes moved in place.  
 Fixed a bug where glasses didn’t disappear from the avatar even after being removed when returning to the garden.  
 Added a check for the achievements "Koi Collector" and "Cat Nurturer" when starting the game. If you believe these achievements were earned but didn’t pop or update, restart the game to resolve the issue.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Steam Workshop and custom 3D file support, grass system rework
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have released an update with the following details:

 Support importing 3D GLTF models into the game from files or Steam Workshop
 Rework the grass system to eliminate distortion issues
 Fix overlapping harvest HUD that makes harvesting difficult
 Fix some minor bugs

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where item names were not displayed on certain screens when the language was set to Japanese  
 Fixed a bug where the highlight and HUD would get stuck upon exiting construction mode in some cases  
 Added a loading indicator when loading or disconnecting online

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Fix bug where objects cannot be moved
 Fix bug in character creation where selection highlight doesn't disappear when choosing different options

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Fix several bugs related to online mode:

 Host does not reload garden when disbanding
 Recently placed objects get stuck when entering online session
